old_caption: The video captures a close-up view of four incense sticks burning against a dark background. Each stick emits a thin, steady stream of smoke that rises gracefully into the air, creating a serene and meditative atmosphere. The smoke is predominantly light blue, with subtle hints of white, and it gently curves upward, forming delicate, wispy tendrils that drift slowly across the frame. The incense sticks themselves are slender and cylindrical, with a reddish-brown tip that glows faintly, indicating their active burning state. The dark background provides a stark contrast to the bright, ethereal smoke, making the incense sticks and their smoke stand out prominently. There are no other objects or characters present in the scene, and the camera remains stationary throughout the video, focusing solely on the tranquil and soothing display of the burning incense sticks and their smoke.

caption: The video captures five slender incense sticks, each marked by a short red band near its upper end, standing at fixed tilted angles against a pure black background. Translucent blue-white smoke streams continuously from the tip of every stick, leaning toward the upper-left of the frame. Throughout the excerpt the sticks themselves never move, while the plumes lengthen and shift as fresh smoke rises from the anchored tips. The separate columns, smooth and laminar near their sources, progressively deform and fold into one another. The plumes from the middle and right sticks intertwine into a broader, wavy, turbulent mass overhead, whereas the leftmost stream stays comparatively coherent yet still undulates. The overall smoke pattern grows billowy and folded across the visible span, with no change to the sticks, their red bands, or the surrounding darkness.
